svg.title: Колесо для пресса стоя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two phases of standing ab-wheel rollout in true side view. The same single compact abdominal wheel with one axle and both hands gripping its side handles. Feet stay at same point and knees NEVER touch the floor. Left phase: starting standing pike, toes/feet on floor, hips high, slight bend in knees and wheel on floor close in front of toes. Right phase: wheel rolled far forward, arms nearly straight overhead, toes firmly on floor and body forms long nearly horizontal line. Same feet and facing direction. No kneeling, no hand placed on floor, no exercise ball. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
